resources.string: Tap Start. PCAPdroid starts reading the game\'s traffic and the game opens: log in and your account loads here.
Start Honkai: Star Rail and click to start. If you are already in game, log out and back in.
Log in and your account loads here.
The game was already running when the capture started, so it missed the login. Log out to the start screen and back in. If the game just updated, this app may need an update too.
Saved from your last session. Tap Start and log in to bring it up to date.
The capture is off. Share the account file to import it on another device, or tap Start to bring it up to date.
Open StarRailSim on this phone to load them, or share the account file to import it on another device.
StarRailSim is up to date. Changes you make in game show up there as they happen.
%1$s. Close the app and open it again.
This app reads the game\'s traffic through PCAPdroid, a free capture app. Install it from Google Play, then tap Start again.
Honkai: Star Rail is not installed on this phone.
PCAPdroid did not start the capture. Tap Start and allow it.
PCAPdroid captures only Honkai: Star Rail\'s traffic, and it never leaves this phone. Android shows a key icon while it runs.
